U7/U6

Requires: Divine Combination You have decided to master the full capabilities of your Super Saiyan God, keeping the ki within your body to enhance all capabilities. You may now apply Super Saiyan Grade 4 to the Super Saiyan God Power-Up.

When you would end this Power-Up, your aura bursts out in a moment of uncontrolled power. You gain +4 Power Bonus until the end of your next turn. Afterwards gaining 2 Ranks of Exhaustion.
